title: Closing remarks and wishing for the old days
summary: The tape ends; Pope has nothing to add and wishes he could live those days again.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: We're just about out of tape here. Is there any other thing that you can think of you'd like to tell about or think we should know?

I don't remember anything else. I hope the next time you come through I'll have something a little bit better, you understand. Well, we'll try to see you again sometime. I'm going to get on the next one, you know.
We certainly appreciate the interview and also your daughter who said a few words.
I know. I wish I could live those days over again. But you take the seltzer man, though, it's a lost dog.
Well, I might ask how much is it?
A lost dog. I don't think that'll ever happen again. No.
